items.product_description:
Fabric: Lightweight woven polyester fabric with an airy drape that feels breezy, floaty, and photo-ready on warm days.

Family story: A fresh matching sundress moment for mom and daughter, made for studio photos, resort dinners, birthdays, and summer afternoons.

Print: "Ivory Dot" pairs a soft ivory base with tiny black polka dots for a clean, playful mother-daughter look.

Design details: Square neckline, ruched bodice, petite puff sleeves, gathered waist, and a softly flowing midi skirt.

Care: Machine wash cold on gentle, line dry, do not bleach, and use a cool iron inside-out if needed.

Size range: Girls Child 1-2 Years to Child 9-10 Years; Mother S to Mother L.

The Ivory Dot Mommy and Me Dresses are made for sunlit getaways, family photos, and slow summer afternoons. The lightweight woven fabric keeps the look airy, while the ruched bodice, square neckline, and tiny black dots give both mom and mini a polished, playful silhouette.

From birthday brunches to vacation dinners, this matching puff-sleeve dress set feels sweet without losing its easy charm. The ivory-and-black palette keeps styling simple, and the gathered midi skirt pairs just as easily with ballet flats and bows as it does with woven bags and family snapshots.

Key Features:


Airy woven feel: Lightweight polyester keeps the silhouette easy and warm-weather friendly.

Square neckline: A clean neckline frames the dotted bodice with a polished vintage-inspired shape.

Petite puff sleeves: Soft shoulder volume keeps the silhouette sweet and photo-ready.

Ruched bodice: Gentle front ruching adds texture while keeping the fit relaxed and wearable.

Mom and mini matching: Coordinated mother-and-daughter styling makes family dressing feel effortless.


Choose your sizes and bring home a dotted ivory matching dress set that feels ready for every warm-weather memory.
